author: /root/r8_terminal_peer/geo348_plan_peer
checks: Matching and nonmatching fgets paths call __real_fgets exactly once.
Matching and nonmatching fflush paths call __real_fflush exactly once.
Matching paths restore entry errno before original call and original result errno before returning.
Only stdin and stdout FILE pointers are observed; NULL/other streams are direct pass-through.
No stdout/stderr diagnostic writes; snprintf stack buffer and write only dedicated checked FD.
Both dedicated descriptors strictly numeric >2, distinct writable regular files and distinct inodes.
Initial event file empty/offset0; status exact64 bytes and eight uint64 values validated.
Status native uint64 layout agrees with Python =8Q on same Linux process.
fgets NULL records feof/ferror and distinguishes error from EOF.
Monotonic timestamp clock/overflow failures mark faults; writes count attempts/successes and faults.
Kill between successful write and status success is conservatively invalid.
No retry of original fgets/fflush, no extra stdout flush, no timeout or protocol changes.
static original source callsites and O0 compile receipts retained in preparation package; no symbol-hit claim from source alone.
limits: Static code review only; no C compile/link/ELF run, ABI test, wrapper symbol-hit calibration or product acceptance.
The wrapper is single-thread/Linux-only; concurrent process/thread use is outside the draft contract.
Runtime injected errno/I/O/partial write controls and C withdrawal/restoration remain unrun.
Underlying event regular-file writes add diagnostic overhead, so timings are never official product performance samples.
